WITH filtered_tracks AS (
  SELECT mt.Name AS media_type_name,
         t.UnitPrice AS unit_price,
         1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds AS size_per_millisecond
  FROM Track AS t
  JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804
), media_type_averages AS (
  SELECT media_type_name,
         AVG(unit_price) AS average_list_price,
         AVG(size_per_millisecond) AS average_size_per_millisecond
  FROM filtered_tracks
  GROUP BY media_type_name
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_size_per_millisecond) AS across_media_type_average
  FROM media_type_averages
)
SELECT m.media_type_name AS media_type_name,
       m.average_list_price AS average_list_price,
       m.average_size_per_millisecond AS average_size_per_millisecond,
       m.average_size_per_millisecond / o.across_media_type_average AS relative_average
FROM media_type_averages AS m
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE o.across_media_type_average IS NOT NULL
